purpose: Review a genuine shared-mask/common-latent synthetic response family, its actual fixed-draw estimators and owned retained replay, without claiming completion of the required final family calibration series.

scope_and_authority.scope: Two through eight distinct estimator-level synthetic response components sharing one exact development template, q/w, grid, instruments, horizon and mask law.
scope_and_authority.not_adopted: No m=1 exemption from the explicit mixed-true-effect calibration requirement; no new estimator, scientific acceptance threshold, market admission or original-AST joint-truth claim.

findings.warranted_conclusion: No substantiated defect was found in the reviewed bounded family capability. The fixed and adversarial tests plus actual owned replay support this implementation slice only.
joint_law: Components are explicitly distinct synthetic responses, sorted by stable identity. The same exact model supplies all q/w values and scenario probabilities.

One common uniform lattice state and one joint mask index advance once per complete timestamp. Response/instrument states and common-choice streams are identity-separated. All states advance even on wholly ineligible timestamps.
One rational lattice covers all model scenario thresholds. False and unknown conditions use p_other; no invalid scenario is clipped or silently omitted.

The world is a coherent vector under its declared mask/latent stress law. Zero common_share does not assert independence, and separate component outputs are not counted as independent outer replications.
Synthetic candidate/data identities and raw_AST_executed=false prevent a claim that these distinct responses are faithful outputs of a common original market-price AST.
estimator_and_events: The family pipeline invokes the existing stationary_bootstrap.calculate for each actual generated component, with primary_count from the owned plan, assigned delta/direction, bound base_length and the same explicit bootstrap seed.
Actual integration observes the same bootstrap path hashes across components and retains every case/draw record for a separate process replay.
Boundary events only use boundary-truth components. A legitimate planted-alternative support is not a boundary error.

A known miss/error remains true despite unavailable siblings. Missing required coverage never becomes joint coverage success; information gaps have no decisive event while technical/model failures remain unavailable.
Monte Carlo instability can suppress a decisive classification but does not erase actual interval miscoverage.
The deadline is shared across the complete family pipeline; a later component does not receive a fresh full allowance.
ownership_and_retention: Operator-only dispatch, reserved input/result namespaces, development-only plan/execution/diagnostic ownership and exact diagnostic lineage are preserved.
Family size is checked against the owned plan; caller-supplied delta/base_length fields are not accepted. Effects derive from the existing assigned criterion.
A private assessment-class plan cannot enter through a development diagnostic wrapper. Protected/operations diagnostic classes are rejected before dependent binding reads.
The existing retention mechanism captures exact source/cases/payload before child work, preserves interrupted inputs, rejects changed same-key requests and retries from retained sources.

Fresh replay compares every retained case/draw byte and complete result hash. Commitment rechecks dependencies, inputs, source and runtime; family input/result edges participate in the typed revocation graph.
Completed keys return immutable historical results; this does not grant current scientific usability. Existing single-claim request/calculation branches remain distinct.

checks.counting_note: Ten fixed oracles, nine adversarial cases, two actual integrations and one dispatch case. No repeated preliminary execution is counted again. Other parent-run regressions are not promoted into a full-repository test claim here.
checks.oracle_timing: Expected rates/thresholds and event oracles were authored before reading family_models implementation. The implementation existed by the first oracle execution, so no red oracle run is claimed.

limitations: The actual owned observation is one development world. Both components are inconclusive, and detection is false; no power or calibration acceptance claim follows.
The complete frozen 256-world-per-cohort final family runner/count integration is not implemented by this capability step.
Same-template masks/q/w do not cover arbitrary aligned heterogeneous reports or different original-claim outcome relationships.
The law does not establish original-AST horizon overlap, raw-price consistency, endogenous missingness, empirical nuisance adequacy or independently sampled ideal PRNG streams.

Adversarial pipeline cases mock bootstrap outputs to isolate state/event extraction. Host and revocation graph cases use explicitly synthetic owned metadata and do not demonstrate genuine full plan validity.
No actual protected market evaluation, paid model request, independent real model-quality assessment, scientific allocation/freeze, full-process calibration or economic usefulness was established.
No full repository suite or exhaustive old-source replay inventory was executed by this reviewer. Host/OS trust and resource-accounting limitations remain.
